title: View Kind nemar.table, Version 1
description: A generic table, applied to a view declaration whose kind is nemar.table and kind_version 1, on top of the envelope. One stored TSV file read as the role table; a renderer shows the declared columns in the order declared, one row per data row, each cell as its stored text, and offers the file for download. A generic kind: no base, no inputs, no transform, no parameters and no dimensions.

base.description: A generic kind has no base.

base_version.description: A generic kind has no base.

inputs.description: A table is stored data only.
